## Workload

Priya Anand completed the grading work during 334 rostered hours. The review covered 587 reads, equivalent to 1.8 reads per hour. This provides a summary of the workload completed during the review period and records the volume of material assessed against the available working time.

## Quality

A further 52 reads were checked as part of the quality review. The level of agreement was 76.9 per cent. Feedback was provided on borderline background cases to support consistency in grading and to identify areas requiring further attention.

The grader was Priya Anand, and the review was also completed by Priya Anand.
